pkgconfig.usr/lib64/pkgconfig/wayland-client.pc:
prefix=/usr
includedir=${prefix}/include
libdir=${prefix}/lib64

datarootdir=${prefix}/share
pkgdatadir=${pc_sysrootdir}${datarootdir}/wayland

Name: Wayland Client
Description: Wayland client side library
Version: 1.26.0
Requires.private: libffi
Libs: -L${libdir} -lwayland-client -lm
Libs.private: -pthread -lrt
Cflags: -I${includedir}
pkgconfig.usr/lib64/pkgconfig/wayland-cursor.pc:
prefix=/usr
includedir=${prefix}/include
libdir=${prefix}/lib64

Name: Wayland Cursor
Description: Wayland cursor helper library
Version: 1.26.0
Requires.private: wayland-client
Libs: -L${libdir} -lwayland-cursor
Cflags: -I${includedir}
prefix=/usr
includedir=${prefix}/include

Name: wayland-egl-backend
Description: Backend wayland-egl interface
Version: 3
Cflags: -I${includedir}
pkgconfig.usr/lib64/pkgconfig/wayland-egl.pc:
prefix=/usr
includedir=${prefix}/include
libdir=${prefix}/lib64

Name: wayland-egl
Description: Frontend wayland-egl library
Version: 18.1.0
Requires: wayland-client
Libs: -L${libdir} -lwayland-egl
Cflags: -I${includedir}
pkgconfig.usr/lib64/pkgconfig/wayland-scanner.pc:
prefix=/usr
bindir=${prefix}/bin
includedir=${prefix}/include

datarootdir=${prefix}/share
pkgdatadir=${pc_sysrootdir}${datarootdir}/wayland
wayland_scanner=${bindir}/wayland-scanner

Name: Wayland Scanner
Description: Wayland scanner
Version: 1.26.0
Cflags: -I${includedir}
pkgconfig.usr/lib64/pkgconfig/wayland-server.pc:
prefix=/usr
includedir=${prefix}/include
libdir=${prefix}/lib64

datarootdir=${prefix}/share
pkgdatadir=${pc_sysrootdir}${datarootdir}/wayland

Name: Wayland Server
Description: Server side implementation of the Wayland protocol
Version: 1.26.0
Requires.private: libffi
Libs: -L${libdir} -lwayland-server -lm
Libs.private: -pthread -lrt
Cflags: -I${includedir}
pkgconfig.usr/share/pkgconfig/wayland-protocols.pc:
prefix=/usr
includedir=${prefix}/include
datarootdir=${prefix}/share
pkgdatadir=${pc_sysrootdir}${datarootdir}/wayland-protocols

Name: Wayland Protocols
Description: Wayland protocol files
Version: 1.49
pkgconfig.usr/lib64/pkgconfig/xkbcommon.pc:
prefix=/usr
includedir=${prefix}/include
libdir=${prefix}/lib64

xkb_root=/usr/share/xkeyboard-config-2
xkb_extra_path=/etc/xkb
xkb_unversioned_extensions_path=/usr/share/xkeyboard-config.d
xkb_versioned_extensions_path=/usr/share/xkeyboard-config-2.d

Name: xkbcommon
Description: XKB API common to servers and clients
Version: 1.13.1
Libs: -L${libdir} -lxkbcommon
Cflags: -I${includedir}
pkgconfig.usr/lib64/pkgconfig/libffi.pc:
prefix=/usr
exec_prefix=/usr
libdir=/usr/lib64
toolexeclibdir=${libdir}
includedir=/usr/include

Name: libffi
Description: Library supporting Foreign Function Interfaces
Version: 3.5.2
Libs: -L${toolexeclibdir} -lffi
Cflags: -I${includedir}

path_derivation: Only prefix, exec_prefix, includedir, libdir, bindir and datarootdir assignments with literal /usr roots are rebased. All other bytes, versions and requirements remain original.
